visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a sleeveless, floor-length silver sequined dress, is positioned center-frame on a stage. She holds a transverse silver flute to her lips, fingers moving rapidly over the keys. Behind her, a large white screen displays a vertical table with blue headers and numerical data, appearing to be an event or raffle list. (2) Camera angle remains eye-level. Graphical overlays appear in the lower third: two square album covers, one featuring anime characters and the other featuring a group of male performers. The performer maintains a rhythmic swaying motion, her body posture poised. She wears clear in-ear monitors and a wireless transmitter is visible on her back waist. (3) The performance continues as she maintains focus on the instrument. She occasionally glanced towards the camera with a subtle smile. Small red heart icons and star-shaped sparkles occasionally drift across the screen as visual effects. The background screen remains static, showing listed items and pricing data in Chinese characters.

The percussion remains consistent, but the harmonic structure becomes more major-inflected and upbeat. No speech or ambient environmental noise is audible in this studio-quality mix. The entire recording is pristine with a very high signal-to-noise ratio.
